searchText: EthJS passes blockchain/state/transaction tests without problems 🙂 Besu is failing 10 of these (using `--fork=Prague`) This should fix 6 of them https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/1121 4 to go 😅 I have a potentially in depth question about one of the v1.3.0 tests... Revm is passing state tests I would like to do some static analysis on mainnet bytecode. Does someone know if there is a quick way to download all deployed bytecode on mainnet? And, if possible, also a duplication count of said bytecode (for instance proxy contracts will be duplicated a lot) Or maybe a team has such dataset? 🙂
